name: Letter to the Web lead
normative-structure: The Letter to the Web lead answers for the demand Letter to the Web takes up from the work board: it assesses each taken demand in the terms of the faces Letter to the Web serves, turns what is Letter to the Web's work into work its own offices do, posts what another micro-enterprise does back on the board, and gives back what is not Letter to the Web's work with its reasons. It staffs nothing outside Letter to the Web, does not hand a thread to a chosen enterprise, and does not accept its own results.
theory-basis: Rendanheyi sanquan: a micro-enterprise's decision right (what it takes) and personnel right (who does it) are its own; its lead staffs only from its own offices
